name: operant
description: A portable operating discipline for AI agents — outcome-first communication, verify-before-done, risk-aware execution across coding and non-coding work. Ten Principles, 18 references, 18 playbooks, gate checklists, a 28-scenario behavioral eval suite, ten code-enforced safety gates with self-tests, a config-surface auditor, a mechanized release check, and a continuous-learning loop. Any model, any harness.
